Author: Zhyra
Name: Gardener
Punchline: Track and tend your outdoor garden patches from anywhere, then sweep the plot in one pass.
Description: Keeps a persistent journal of every outdoor garden bed you own — personal, FC and shared estates — and reminds you when a crop needs tending, fertilizing or harvesting no matter where you are in the world. While standing at the plot, runs a guarded tend-all, fertilize-all, harvest-all or plant-a-plan sweep across the patch, and plans crossbreed layouts from a bundled dataset. Never travels, mounts or pathfinds on your behalf. This automates gameplay, which violates the FFXIV User Agreement and can get your account penalized or banned; use entirely at your own risk.
